query: I created a CInvoice and need to attach 3 CSubscriptions to it. I sent PUT /CInvoice/<id> with subscriptionsIds: [a, b, c] but I get HTTP 403. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Explain that many-to-many links cannot be set via the parent record's PUT — that returns 403
Use the relationship endpoint instead: POST /CInvoice/<id>/subscriptions with {"id": "<subscriptionId>"} per relation, or {"ids": [...]} in one call
Note that manyToOne links DO work via the <linkName>Id field on PUT — only the multi-link case breaks
Reference api-endpoints.md (setting relationships on records) and common-errors.md (403 cases)
notes: The 403 -> relationship-endpoint mapping is a frequent wall.
